<div class="card-body">
'''Black 3''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ブラック3</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを1名乗せられる。戦闘力と回避値を使うためには、パイロットが乗っていなければならない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-300o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">DS-61-3の操縦するタイ・ファイター。コレリアの猛獣スライス・ハウンドを内部ハッチに描いてある。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Black 3.

'''Card text:''' May add 1 pilot. Must have a pilot aboard to use power and maneuver.

'''Lore:''' A TIE fighter piloted by DS-61-3. A Corellian slice-hound is painted on the inner hatch.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names power and maneuver; the English also names hyperspeed.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Black 3]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
